## Security notice

Do **not** use this template for vulnerabilities involving authentication bypass, session or invite-gate bypass, RLS/data leaks, open redirects, XSS, unsafe URL handling, API abuse, or exposed secrets. Please follow the private reporting instructions in [`SECURITY.md`](../../SECURITY.md) instead.
